margin-right: 1em;\"\u003E\n \u003Cimg border=\"0\" src=\"https:\/\/lh3.googleusercontent.com\/-4oJ5tUO1cqc\/XrwuWg1V8iI\/AAAAAAAAAp8\/LXLnGQa71CQnznIQ6dtAY2zFT57Axb8CgCLcBGAsYHQ\/s1600\/1589390922169184-3.png\" width=\"400\"\u003E\n \u003C\/a\u003E\n\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ENEET TOPIC: WILSON'S DISEASE\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EWilson's disease is a rare autosomal recessive inherited disorder that causes copper to accumulate in the liver, brain and other vital organs.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EMost people with Wilson's disease are diagnosed between the ages of 5-35.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ESigns and symptoms depends upon the parts of the body effected by the disease.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EFatigue, loss of appetite, or abdominal pain.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EGolden brown eye discoloration ( kayser-fleischer ring)\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EFluid buildup in the legs\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EProblems with speech, swallowing, or physical coordination.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EUncontrolled movements and muscle stiffness\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ETreatment:\u0026nbsp;
